# Email Patch Diff

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EmailPatchDiff`](gmeow-EmailPatchDiff.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EmailPatchDiff>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

A patch or diff artifact between email body or header states, typically between a variant message and its canonical counterpart. Treated as a MIME-like [`BodyPart`](gmeow-BodyPart.md) so it can carry [`mediaType`](../properties/gmeow-mediaType.md), [`contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md), and derivation links.
